newTerms.Chief of the Archangels of Nebadon: Jefe de los Arcángeles de Nebadon

forcedChoices.reason: An adjective that modifies the noun «Espíritu» agrees with it; a standalone noun for her role (asociada, codirectora, cogobernante, compañera, consejera) is feminine, because the English says «she».
The ordinal stands for the Mother Spirit, whom the English calls «she».
Spanish forces a gender on «codirector»; the English uses «her» for the Universe Spirit in the same paragraph.

forcedChoices.choice: La Resplandeciente Estrella Matutina ... un administrador (33:4.4)
forcedChoices.reason: The noun «Estrella» is feminine, but the English calls this being «he»; predicate nouns about Gabriel stay masculine.
«Unión» is a feminine noun; the participle agrees with it, while pronouns for Immanuel stay masculine.
Spanish ordinal abbreviation for the English «st» inside the same sup tag.
«sus» alone can be read as «his»; «de ustedes» keeps the English «your».
The English «their» can be the mortals' or the daughters'; «sus» keeps both readings open.
